head_commit.message:
fix(#189): native Soroban Merkle verification, 7 contract tests, ZK cross-check, CI, README, PR description

- Replace Groth16/PLONK stub verifier with native SHA-256 Merkle recomputation
  (contracts/fraud_verifier/src/verifier.rs, types.rs, lib.rs)
- Strip Arkworks deps from Cargo.toml (soroban-sdk only)
- Add tests.rs: 7 tests covering registration, fraud slash, expired window,
  duplicate challenge, unregistered batch, and fraud flag readability
- Add zk/test/crosscheck.test.ts: 6 tests verifying TS/Rust hash convention
  consistency (domain tags, path_bit orientation, BATCH_DEPTH)
- Add .github/workflows/zk.yml: cargo test + npm test in CI
- Commit docs/zk_fraud_proof_architectural_review.md to repo
- Add zk/README.md with constants, test runner, build steps, hash convention
- Update PR_DESCRIPTION.md: explicit #189 acceptance criteria mapping,
  deferred items with follow-up issue numbers (#190, #191, #192)
- Token transfer deferred to #190 (documented in lib.rs and PR description)
- Manual challenger model documented; auto-triggering scoped to #191
